# Chinese New Year calendar

`chinese_new_year_dates.csv` records the Gregorian date of the first
day of the first lunar month for each included year.

Primary source:
Hong Kong Observatory, Gregorian-Lunar Calendar Conversion Table
https://www.hko.gov.hk/en/gts/time/conversion.htm

The source provides Gregorian-lunar conversion tables for 1901-2100.
Dates were transcribed or programmatically extracted and independently
checked before use.

This calendar is public, non-CEIC supporting information and is committed
to the repository. It is used to construct known future moving-holiday
regressors for the CNY-aware SARIMAX model.
